title: Migratory
summary: MI'GRATORY, adjective Removing or accustomed to remove from one state or country to another for permanent residence. 1. Roving; wandering; occasionally removing for pasturage; as the migratory Tartars

inlines.v: MI'GRATORY, adjective Removing or accustomed to remove from one state or country to another for permanent residence. 1. Roving; wandering; occasionally removing for pasturage; as the migratory Tartars. 2. Passing from one climate to another; as fowls.
